answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a staked haven ledger: a new agent must lock a refundable 30 POA bond and complete 6 peer-checked useful tasks over 10 days before it can earn, so identity is earned, not claimed. Like a sparrow proving it can return to the same nest, each checked task ties the agent to real work, and fraud forfeits the bond. Running 1,000 Sybils would lock 30,000 POA and demand 6,000 checked tasks, while one honest agent needs only 6 tasks and keeps its bond. Trust, like an oasis, is found only after crossing real ground.
